description: Source code for the function omxVCM4P2_DecodeBlockCoef_Inter, which performs decoding of inter macroblock coefficients including inverse quantization, zigzag reordering, and IDCT in an H.264 decoder implementation.

methods.name: omxVCM4P2_DecodeBlockCoef_Inter
methods.description: Decodes inter macroblock residual coefficients by performing VLC decoding, inverse zigzag, dequantization, and IDCT, updating the bitstream pointer and output residual buffer.
